body:
RanEddie builds browsers, games and apps that share one account: your **RanEddie ID**.

- **Fizz Browser** — getting started with Fizz.
- **Snake Brawl** — playing, multiplayer and cloud saves.
- **Support** — answers to common questions and how to reach us.

## Need help?
If you can't find what you're looking for, email [contact@raneddie.com](mailto:contact@raneddie.com).

title: Create a RanEddie ID
description: One account for every RanEddie product.
body:
A RanEddie ID lets you sign in to RanEddie products and keep your progress and purchases safe.

## Before you start
- You need an email address you can open.
- You must be at least 13 years old.

## Create your account
1. Go to [id.raneddie.com/sign-up](https://id.raneddie.com/sign-up).
2. Enter your email and choose a password of at least 15 characters. A short phrase works well.
3. Enter your date of birth and country.
4. Complete the quick security check.
5. Pick a username — this is how other players see you.
6. Enter the 6-digit code we email you.

## Tips for a strong password
Use a phrase of several words that you don't use anywhere else. Passwords that appeared in known data leaks are rejected automatically.

title: Sign in
description: Sign in to your RanEddie ID on any device.
body:
## Sign in
1. Select **Sign in** at the top of raneddie.com, or go to [id.raneddie.com/sign-in](https://id.raneddie.com/sign-in).
2. Enter your email, then your password.

## Signing in on a new device
When you sign in on a device we haven't seen before, we email you a 6-digit code to confirm it's you.

## Two-step verification
If you turned on an authenticator app, you'll be asked for the 6-digit code from the app after your password.

## The page keeps loading
Make sure you're on **id.raneddie.com**, check your connection and turn off content blockers for the page, then try again.

title: Reset your password
description: Forgot your password? Get back in with a code sent to your email.
body:
## Reset your password
1. On the sign-in page, enter your email and select **Forgot password?**
2. Enter the 6-digit code we send to your email.
3. Choose a new password of at least 15 characters.

You're signed in right away, and you're signed out on your other devices.

## Didn't get the email?
Check your spam folder and wait a minute, then select **Send a new code**.

title: Tips for getting the most out of Snake Brawl
description: Small things that make a big difference in Snake Brawl.
body:
- **Showdown:** The poison starts closing in after 25 seconds — head toward the centre early.
- **Endless:** Boosting burns length — use it to escape or to cut off another snake.
- **Duo Showdown:** A knocked-out partner respawns after 5 seconds while you stay alive — play safe when they're down.
- **Brawlers and upgrades:** Each power level adds 6% health and damage.
- **Snake Pass:** Snake Pass+ costs 1,200 coins — no real money.
- **Play with a friend:** Only two phones can play together: the host and one friend.
- **Clubs:** Some clubs need a minimum number of trophies.
- **Settings:** Low graphics quality can make the game smoother on older phones.

## Keep exploring
[See everything Snake Brawl can do](/snake-brawl).

## Why it happens
- Trophies depend on your final rank
- Higher trophy counts face stronger bots

## How to fix it
1. Focus on surviving longer rather than knockouts.
2. Collect power cubes from crates for +10% health and damage each.
3. Upgrade your favourite brawler.

## Related
- [Showdown](/docs/snake-brawl-showdown)
- [Troubleshooting Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-troubleshooting)

title: Endless
description: In Snake Brawl: play the classic grow-as-big-as-you-can mode on a bigger map.
body:
With Snake Brawl you can play the classic grow-as-big-as-you-can mode on a bigger map.

## How to
1. Choose Endless on the main menu.
2. Eat orbs to grow.
3. Avoid crashing your head into other snakes.

## Tip
Boosting burns length — use it to escape or to cut off another snake.

## Having trouble?
See [My snake keeps shrinking](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-my-snake-keeps-shrinking).

title: My snake keeps shrinking
description: Snake Brawl: what to do when this happens.
body:
## Why it happens
- Holding Boost burns length

## How to fix it
1. Release the Boost button when you don't need speed.
2. Eat the food other snakes leave behind.

## Related
- [Endless](/docs/snake-brawl-endless)
- [Troubleshooting Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-troubleshooting)

title: Duo Showdown
description: In Snake Brawl: team up with your club's duo partner against four other pairs.
body:
With Snake Brawl you can team up with your club's duo partner against four other pairs.

## How to
1. Join or create a club.
2. Choose Play Duo on the club screen.
3. Watch your partner's card under the minimap for their health and respawn timer.

## Tip
A knocked-out partner respawns after 5 seconds while you stay alive — play safe when they're down.

## Having trouble?
See [I can't find Duo Showdown](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-i-can-t-find-duo-showdown).

title: I can't find Duo Showdown
description: Snake Brawl: what to do when this happens.
body:
## Why it happens
- You're not in a club yet

## How to fix it
1. Open the club screen and join or create a club.
2. Choose Play Duo from the club screen.

## Related
- [Duo Showdown](/docs/snake-brawl-duo-showdown)
- [Troubleshooting Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-troubleshooting)

title: Brawlers and upgrades
description: In Snake Brawl: unlock brawlers and raise their power level.
body:
With Snake Brawl you can unlock brawlers and raise their power level.

## How to
1. Open the Brawlers screen.
2. Pick a brawler.
3. Spend coins to upgrade its power level (1 to 7).

## Tip
Each power level adds 6% health and damage.

## Having trouble?
See [I can't afford an upgrade](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-i-can-t-afford-an-upgrade).

title: I can't afford an upgrade
description: Snake Brawl: what to do when this happens.
body:
## Why it happens
- Not enough coins

## How to fix it
1. Play matches to earn coins by rank, knockouts and length.
2. Claim the free gift in the shop every 4 hours.
3. Claim Snake Pass rewards.

## Related
- [Brawlers and upgrades](/docs/snake-brawl-brawlers-and-upgrades)
- [Troubleshooting Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-troubleshooting)

title: Snake Pass
description: In Snake Brawl: earn rewards across a 30-tier season.
body:
With Snake Brawl you can earn rewards across a 30-tier season.

## How to
1. Open the SNAKE PASS card on the main menu.
2. Play matches to earn pass XP (150 XP per tier).
3. Select CLAIM ALL to collect your rewards.

## Tip
Snake Pass+ costs 1,200 coins — no real money.

## Having trouble?
See [A reward turned into coins](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-a-reward-turned-into-coins).

title: A reward turned into coins
description: Snake Brawl: what to do when this happens.
body:
## Why it happens
- You already owned that item

## How to fix it
1. This is expected: rewards you already own are converted into coins.

## Related
- [Snake Pass](/docs/snake-brawl-snake-pass)
- [Troubleshooting Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-troubleshooting)

title: Play with a friend
description: In Snake Brawl: play with one friend on the same Wi-Fi network.
body:
With Snake Brawl you can play with one friend on the same Wi-Fi network.

## How to
1. Connect both Android phones to the same Wi-Fi network (or use a hotspot).
2. On the host phone, choose FRIENDS and create a room.
3. On the second phone, join the room — or enter the host phone's local IP address.
4. The host picks Together, Versus, Snake Ball or Egg Heist and a map.

## Tip
Only two phones can play together: the host and one friend.

## Having trouble?
See [My friend can't find my room](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-my-friend-can-t-find-my-room).

title: My friend can't find my room
description: Snake Brawl: what to do when this happens.
body:
## Why it happens
- The phones are on different networks
- The network blocks devices from seeing each other
- Different versions of the game

## How to fix it
1. Make sure both phones are on the same Wi-Fi network, or use one phone as a hotspot.
2. Enter the host phone's local IP address manually.
3. Update both phones to the latest version.

## Related
- [Play with a friend](/docs/snake-brawl-play-with-a-friend)
- [Troubleshooting Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-troubleshooting)

title: Clubs

With Snake Brawl you can join or create a club and play with a duo partner.

1. Choose a club with a lower trophy requirement.

- [Clubs](/docs/snake-brawl-clubs)
- [Troubleshooting Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-troubleshooting)

title: Settings

body:
With Snake Brawl you can adjust sound, controls and graphics.

## How to
1. Open Settings.
2. Change sound, vibration, damage numbers, graphics quality, auto-aim, left-handed controls, joystick size or camera distance.

Low graphics quality can make the game smoother on older phones.

## Having trouble?
See [The game feels slow](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-the-game-feels-slow).

title: The game feels slow

body:
## Why it happens

title: BlueBear Media overview
description: BlueBear Media is RanEddie's entertainment company — film, television, streaming, animation, music and theme parks under one roof.
body:
BlueBear Media is RanEddie's entertainment company — film, television, streaming, animation, music and theme parks under one roof.

## What's included
- **BlueBear Pictures** — Feature films from first draft to premiere.
- **BlueBear TV** — Series, live events, kids' programming and channels.
- **BlueBear Stream** — Films and series on every screen, with profiles and downloads.
- **BlueBear Parks & Resorts** — Rides, shows and hotels inspired by BlueBear stories.
- **BlueBear Animation & Music** — Animated films and series, original scores and soundtracks.
- **Studio Tours & Products** — Behind-the-scenes tours, toys, books and collectibles.

## Where you can use it
- Cinemas
- TV
- Streaming
- Parks

## Next steps
- [Get started with BlueBear Media](/docs/bluebear-media-get-started)
- [Visit the BlueBear Media page](/bluebear-media)

title: Get started with BlueBear Media
description: Everything you need for your first day with BlueBear Media.
body:
BlueBear Media: Stories for every screen, and places to live them.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID — [create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- One of the supported platforms: Cinemas, TV, Streaming, Parks.

## Set up
1. Open BlueBear Media on your device.
2. Choose Sign in and sign in with your RanEddie ID.
3. Follow the short welcome tour.

## Try these first
- [BlueBear Stream profiles](/docs/bluebear-media-bluebear-stream-profiles) — give everyone in your household their own profile with its own recommendations and watch list.
- [Downloads](/docs/bluebear-media-downloads) — download films and episodes to watch without a connection.
- [Watch on your TV](/docs/bluebear-media-watch-on-your-tv) — watch BlueBear Stream on a TV, streamer or Lu Stream.
- [Parental controls](/docs/bluebear-media-parental-controls) — control what younger viewers can watch.

title: BlueBear Media availability and requirements
description: Where BlueBear Media is available and what you need to use it.
body:
## Platforms
- Cinemas
- TV
- Streaming
- Parks

## What you need
- A RanEddie ID.
- An internet connection for sign-in, sync and updates.
- The latest version of BlueBear Media and of your device's software.

## Availability
Features and availability can vary by country and region. Some features may arrive in your region later.

title: Sign in to BlueBear Media with your RanEddie ID
description: Use your RanEddie ID to sign in to BlueBear Media.
body:
## Sign in
1. Open BlueBear Media.
2. Choose Sign in.
3. Sign in at id.raneddie.com — you're returned to BlueBear Media automatically.

## On a TV or console
Choose Sign in, then enter the code shown on screen at id.raneddie.com on your phone. See [Sign in on a TV or console](/docs/sign-in-on-a-tv-or-console).

## Trouble signing in?
- [Reset your password](/docs/raneddie-id-reset-password)
- [Why does the sign-in page keep loading?](/docs/sign-in-why-does-the-sign-in-page-keep-loading)

title: BlueBear Media and your privacy
description: What BlueBear Media stores and how you control it.
body:
## What BlueBear Media stores
BlueBear Media stores your BlueBear Stream profiles, watch history, downloads, park tickets and shop orders.

## How it's used
To run BlueBear Media, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside BlueBear Media.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

title: Download or delete your BlueBear Media data
description: Get a copy of your BlueBear Media data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose BlueBear Media and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside BlueBear Media at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your BlueBear Media data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

title: Keep your BlueBear Media account secure
description: Simple steps to protect your BlueBear Media account.
body:
## Protect your RanEddie ID
Your BlueBear Media account is your RanEddie ID, so securing it protects BlueBear Media too.
- Use a unique password of at least 15 characters.
- Turn on [two-step verification](/docs/sign-in-two-step-verification-explained).
- Review [recent sign-ins](/docs/sign-in-review-recent-sign-ins) regularly.
- Keep BlueBear Media updated.

## Watch out for scams
RanEddie will never ask for your password or a verification code. Learn to [recognise phishing](/docs/security-recognise-phishing).

title: AI features in BlueBear Media
description: How BlueBear Media uses AI and how to control it.
body:
## How BlueBear Media uses AI
BlueBear Stream can recommend films and series based on what each profile watches. Recommendations stay inside each profile and can be reset at any time.

## Stay in control
- Review AI suggestions before you use them.
- Turn AI features on or off in BlueBear Media's settings.
- Delete your AI activity from your Account Center.

## Learn more
- [How RanEddie uses AI](/docs/ai-how-raneddie-uses-ai)
- [Turn AI features on or off](/docs/ai-turn-ai-features-on-or-off)

title: Accessibility in BlueBear Media
description: Features that make BlueBear Media easier to use.

title: BlueBear Media for families

body:

## Tips

- Approve purchases before they happen
- Talk to children about what they share online

title: Tips for getting the most out of BlueBear Media
description: Small things that make a big difference in BlueBear Media.
body:
- **BlueBear Stream profiles:** Create a kids' profile for younger viewers — it only shows titles for their age.
- **Downloads:** Download over Wi-Fi to save mobile data.
- **Watch on your TV:** You can also cast from your phone to a TV on the same network.
- **Parental controls:** Profile PINs are separate from your RanEddie ID password.
- **Park tickets:** Add everyone in your party before you check out so tickets are assigned by name.
- **Resort reservations:** Resort guests can link park tickets to their reservation.
- **Studio Tours:** Sets change with productions, so every tour is a little different.
- **BlueBear Shop:** Orders appear in your RanEddie ID so you can track them.

## Keep exploring
[See everything BlueBear Media can do](/bluebear-media).

title: BlueBear Media FAQ
description: Answers to common questions about BlueBear Media.
body:
## Do I need a separate account for BlueBear Stream?
No — sign in with your RanEddie ID.

## Can I watch on more than one device?
Yes. Each profile can watch on its own device.

## Do I need a RanEddie ID for BlueBear Media?
A RanEddie ID lets you sign in, sync and keep your purchases. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account).

## How do I get help with BlueBear Media?
Start with [Troubleshooting BlueBear Media](/docs/bluebear-media-troubleshooting), or [get help](/docs/bluebear-media-get-help).

title: BlueBear Media glossary
description: Terms you'll see in BlueBear Media.
body:
- **Profile** — A personal space in BlueBear Stream with its own recommendations.
- **Maturity level** — The age rating a profile is allowed to watch.
- **Backlot** — Outdoor sets at a film studio.
- **Download** — A copy of a title stored on your device for offline viewing.
- **RanEddie ID** — the account you use across every RanEddie product.

title: BlueBear Stream profiles

1. Open BlueBear Stream and sign in with your RanEddie ID.

title: Recommendations don't match what I watch

body:

- Someone else watched on your profile
- Your watch history is mixed between people

- [Troubleshooting BlueBear Media](/docs/bluebear-media-troubleshooting)

title: Setup is stuck on Wi-Fi
description: Lu: what to do when this happens.

- Wrong Wi-Fi password
- A network that needs a sign-in page

title: Lu Link

With Lu you can copy, paste and hand off between your Lu devices.

1. Sign in to the same RanEddie ID on each device.

title: Copy and paste doesn't move between devices
description: Lu: what to do when this happens.

- Devices signed in with different RanEddie IDs
- Bluetooth is off on one device

description: Lu: what to do when this happens.
body:
## Why it happens
- The earbud's battery is empty
- Dirty speaker mesh

1. Put both earbuds in the case to charge.
2. Clean the mesh gently with a dry, soft brush.

- **Storage** — Files with image transformations and access rules.
- **Realtime & edge functions** — Live updates and server code near your users.
- **Branching** — A database per pull request.

- CLI
- JavaScript
- Python
- Swift
- Kotlin

title: How RanEddie uses AI

## Overview
AI helps across RanEddie products with tasks like summarising, drafting, recognising what's in photos, recommending what to watch and detecting threats. It's there to save you time — you stay in control of what it does.

## Where you'll find it
- workIT Assist and rEmail Assist for writing and summarising
- EditTime for transcripts, captions and scene detection
- Cloudly Photos for search
- Gimbly's AI director
- Protector Y's threat detection
- Recommendations in BlueBear Stream and RanEddie Games

## Your controls
Most AI features can be turned off in each product's settings. See [Turn AI features on or off](/docs/ai-turn-ai-features-on-or-off).

title: RanEddie's AI principles
description: The commitments behind every AI feature.
body:
## Helpful
AI features should solve a real problem and save real time.

## In your control
You choose when to use AI, and you can review, edit or reject what it produces.

## Private
AI features only use the content you ask them to work on, and your content isn't used to show you ads.

## Honest
We label AI-generated content and tell you when AI is involved.

## Safe
We test AI features for harmful outputs and keep improving them.

title: Turn AI features on or off
description: Control AI features across RanEddie products.
body:
## In each product
1. Open the product's Settings.
2. Find the AI or Assist section.
3. Turn individual features on or off.

## For your whole account
In your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account) under Privacy, you can turn off personalised recommendations across RanEddie products.

## Good to know
Some features, like Protector Y's threat detection, rely on AI to keep you safe. Turning them off reduces protection.

title: Review AI-generated content
description: Why and how to check what AI produces.
body:
## AI can make mistakes
AI can sound confident and still be wrong. It can misread a number, invent a detail or miss context.

## What to check
- Names, dates, figures and quotes
- Anything legal, medical or financial
- Tone — does it sound like you?
- Whether anything important was left out

## Tip
Ask the assistant to point to where it found something, then check the source.

title: Write better prompts
description: Get more useful results from AI assistants.
body:
## Be specific
Say what you want, who it's for, how long it should be and the tone.

## Give context
Point the assistant at the right file, thread or section.

## Iterate
Ask follow-ups like 'shorter', 'more formal' or 'add a table'.

## Examples
- Summarise this report in five bullet points for a busy manager.
- Turn these notes into a friendly email to the team.
- Write a formula that totals column C when column B says Paid.

title: What data AI features use
description: Which information AI features work with.
body:
## The content you choose
Assistants work on the document, message, project or photo you ask about.

## Signals for recommendations
Recommendations use activity inside the product, like what a profile watched or what games you played.

## What AI doesn't do
- Use your email or documents to show you ads
- Share your content with other customers
- Make decisions about you without a way to review them

## Fair use
To keep AI features fast for everyone, some have daily limits that depend on your plan.

## What to do
- Wait until the limit resets
- Check your plan for higher limits

title: AI features when you're offline
description: What works without a connection.
body:
## Works offline
- On-device photo search on Lu
- Gimbly flight and tracking
- Protector Y behaviour detection

## Needs a connection
- workIT Assist and rEmail Assist
- EditTime transcription in the cloud
- Recommendations

title: Transparency about AI
description: How we tell you when AI is involved.
body:
## Labels
AI-generated text, images and summaries are marked in RanEddie products.

## Explanations
Many AI features show a short note about how the result was produced.

title: Customising AI tone and style
description: Make AI writing sound like you.
body:
## In the prompt
Ask for a tone: friendly, formal, short, persuasive.

## Writing style
In workIT Assist and rEmail Assist settings, add a short note about how you like to write.

title: AI and sensitive topics
description: How AI handles health, legal and financial questions.
body:
## General information only
AI can explain concepts but isn't a substitute for a doctor, lawyer or financial adviser.

## RanEddie Invest
RanEddie Invest's AI explains terms and news but doesn't recommend what to buy or sell.

title: Accessibility of AI features
description: Using AI features with assistive technology.
body:
## Screen readers
AI panels in RanEddie apps work with screen readers and keyboard navigation.

## Voice input
Dictate prompts on any device that supports voice typing.

title: Glossary of AI terms
description: Plain explanations of common AI words.
body:
## Terms
- **Model** — the system that produces AI results
- **Prompt** — what you ask the AI
- **Summary** — a short version of longer content
- **On-device** — AI that runs on your device
- **Hallucination** — when AI states something that isn't true

title: What is a RanEddie ID?
description: One account for every RanEddie product.
body:
## One account
Your RanEddie ID signs you in to Fizz, Snake Brawl, BlueBear Stream, Lu devices, workIT, Cloudly, rEmail and every other RanEddie product.

## What it holds
- Your name, username and photo
- Your email and password
- Security settings
- Connected products and devices

## Get one
[Create a RanEddie ID](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account).

title: Change your password
description: Update the password for your RanEddie ID.
body:
## Steps
1. Open your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Go to Security.
3. Enter your current password and a new one of at least 15 characters.

## What happens next
You're signed out on your other devices for safety.

title: Choose a strong password
description: Make your password hard to guess and easy to remember.
body:
## Use a passphrase
Four or more random words, like 'river lamp purple tiger', are strong and memorable.

## Avoid
- Names, birthdays and pet names
- Passwords you use anywhere else
- Simple patterns like 123456 or qwerty

## Use a password manager
Protector Y's password manager can create and remember passwords for you.

title: Change your email address
description: Update the email you use to sign in.
body:
## Steps
1. Open Personal information in your Account Center.
2. Add your new email address.
3. Enter the code we send to it.
4. Make it your primary email.

## Tip
Keep your old address until you've confirmed the new one works.

title: Change your username
description: Update how other players and users see you.
body:
## Steps
1. Open Personal information in your Account Center.
2. Edit your username.
3. Save.

## Rules
Usernames are 4–20 characters: letters, numbers, _ and -, starting with a letter.

title: Change your profile photo
description: Add or change your RanEddie ID photo.
body:
## Steps
1. Open Personal information in your Account Center.
2. Select your photo.
3. Upload a new image.

## Good to know
Your photo is visible in RanEddie products where your username appears.

title: Sign out of RanEddie products
description: Sign out on one device or everywhere.
body:
## On this device
Choose Sign out from the product's account menu.

## Everywhere
1. Open Security in your Account Center.
2. Find Active sessions.
3. Revoke the sessions you want to end.

title: Sign in on a TV or console
description: Use a code to sign in on devices without a keyboard.
body:
## Steps
1. Choose Sign in on the TV or console.
2. Note the code shown.
3. Go to id.raneddie.com on your phone and enter the code.

## Tip
Some devices show a QR code — scan it with your phone camera.

title: Why was I asked for a code?
description: When RanEddie ID asks for a verification code.
body:
## New device
We email a 6-digit code when you sign in on a device we haven't seen before.

## Sensitive changes
Changing your email or password may ask you to confirm it's you.

## Didn't try to sign in?
Change your password right away and review your active sessions.

title: I'm not getting verification emails
description: Fix missing sign-in codes.
body:
## Check
- Your spam or junk folder
- That you typed your email correctly
- That your inbox isn't full

## Try
1. Wait a minute.
2. Select Send a new code.
3. Add our address to your contacts.

title: Account locked after too many attempts
description: What to do when sign-in is temporarily blocked.
body:
## Why
After 10 wrong attempts, sign-in is paused for an hour to protect your account.

## What to do
- Wait an hour and try again
- [Reset your password](/docs/raneddie-id-reset-password) if you've forgotten it

title: Recover an account you can't access
description: Get back into your RanEddie ID.
body:
## Forgot password
[Reset it](/docs/raneddie-id-reset-password) with a code sent to your email.

## Lost access to your email
Contact support with as much detail as you can about the account. We'll verify you're the owner.

## Lost your authenticator app
Use a backup code, or contact support.

title: Two-step verification explained
description: Add a second check when you sign in.
body:
## What it is
After your password, you enter a code from an authenticator app. Even if someone learns your password, they can't sign in.

## Turn it on
See [Security and devices](/docs/raneddie-id-security).

title: Set up an authenticator app
description: Use an app to generate sign-in codes.
body:
## Steps
1. Open Security in your Account Center.
2. Select Set up next to Authenticator app.
3. Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
4. Enter the 6-digit code to confirm.

## Tip
Save the secret key somewhere safe in case you change phones.

title: Passkeys
description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN.
body:
## What they are
Passkeys replace passwords with a key stored securely on your device.

## Why use them
- They can't be phished
- Nothing to remember
- Faster sign-in

title: Manage connected products
description: See which games and apps use your RanEddie ID.
body:
## Steps
1. Open Connected products in your Account Center.
2. See each product and when it was connected.
3. Select Disconnect to sign it out everywhere.

title: Sign in with RanEddie ID on other websites
description: Use your RanEddie ID with apps built on baseline.
body:
## How it works
Apps that offer Sign in with RanEddie ID send you to id.raneddie.com. You approve, and you're sent back signed in.

## What they get
Only the details shown on the approval screen.

## Revoke access
Disconnect the app in Connected products.

title: Update your date of birth or country
description: Change the details you gave at sign-up.
body:
## Why it matters
Your age and country decide which features and content are available to you.

## How
Contact support to correct your date of birth. You may be asked to verify it.

title: Minimum age for a RanEddie ID
description: Who can create an account.
body:
## The rule
You must be at least 13 years old to create a RanEddie ID.

## Younger children
Younger children can use some products through a parent's family settings.

title: Delete your RanEddie ID
description: Permanently close your account.
body:
## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep
- Cancel subscriptions
- Use up any balances or credits

## Steps
1. Open Privacy in your Account Center.
2. Select Delete my account.
3. Confirm.

## This can't be undone
Your data in every RanEddie product is deleted.

title: Use RanEddie ID on a shared computer
description: Stay safe on computers other people use.
body:
## Tips
- Use a private window
- Don't save your password in the browser
- Sign out when you're done
- Revoke the session from another device if you forgot

title: Why does the sign-in page keep loading?
description: Fix a stuck sign-in screen.
body:
## Check the address
RanEddie ID only works at **id.raneddie.com**.

## Try
- Turn off content blockers for the page
- Allow third-party cookies for raneddie.com
- Update your browser
- Try another browser

title: Supported browsers
description: Browsers that work with RanEddie ID.
body:
## Supported
- Current versions of popular browsers on Windows, macOS, Android and Lu
- Fizz Browser

## Tip
Keep your browser updated for the best security.

title: Sign in with a different account
description: Switch between RanEddie IDs.
body:
## Steps
1. Sign out from the account menu.
2. Choose Sign in.
3. Enter the other account's email.

title: Merge two RanEddie IDs
description: Can two accounts be combined?
body:
## Not possible
RanEddie IDs can't be merged. Choose the account you want to keep and move what you can — for example, download files from Cloudly and upload them again.

title: Security check during sign-up
description: Why we ask you to confirm you're a person.
body:
## Why
The check stops automated sign-ups and protects everyone.

## If it fails
- Turn off ad or content blockers
- Refresh and try again
- Try another browser

title: Email already in use
description: What it means when sign-up says your email is taken.
body:
## Meaning
There's already a RanEddie ID with that email — probably yours.

## What to do
- Sign in instead
- [Reset your password](/docs/raneddie-id-reset-password) if you've forgotten it

title: Password rejected as leaked
description: Why some passwords aren't allowed.
body:
## Why
We check new passwords against lists of passwords exposed in data breaches elsewhere. Those passwords are easy for attackers to guess.

## What to do
Choose a different, unique password.

title: Review recent sign-ins
description: See where your account was used.
body:
## Steps
1. Open Security in your Account Center.
2. Review Active sessions with device, browser and location.
3. Revoke anything you don't recognise.

title: Account Center tour
description: Everything you can do in your Account Center.
body:
## Sections
- **Overview** — your account at a glance
- **Personal information** — name, username, photo, email
- **Security** — password, authenticator, sessions
- **Connected products** — games and apps
- **Payments & plans** — subscriptions
- **Privacy** — your data and account
- **Preferences** — appearance and language

title: Language and region settings
description: Change the language RanEddie products use.
body:
## Steps
1. Open Preferences in your Account Center.
2. Choose your language.
3. Products update the next time you open them.

title: Use your RanEddie ID with Lu devices
description: Sign in once on your Lu devices.
body:
## What it does
Your RanEddie ID connects Lu Link, Cloudly Backup, Find My Lu and purchases.

## Set up
Sign in during setup or in Settings > RanEddie ID.

title: Business and school accounts
description: RanEddie ID for organisations.
body:
## Managed accounts
Organisations can create and manage RanEddie IDs for members, with single sign-on and admin controls.

## Who to ask
If your account is managed, your administrator handles password resets and access.

title: Contact RanEddie ID support
description: Get help with your account.
body:
## Email
Write to [contact@raneddie.com](mailto:contact@raneddie.com) from the email on your account.

## Include
- Your username
- What you were trying to do
- Any error messages

## Never share
Your password or verification codes — support will never ask for them.

title: RanEddie's privacy commitments
description: How we think about your personal information.
body:
## Our commitments
- We collect what we need to run our products
- We don't sell your personal information
- We don't use the content of your email, documents or files for ads
- You can see, download and delete your data
- We protect your data with strong security

title: What information RanEddie collects
description: The types of data RanEddie products use.
body:
## Information you give us
- Account details like name, email and date of birth
- Content you create and upload
- Payment details

## Information from using products
- Device and app information
- Activity inside products, like what you watched or played
- Diagnostics and crash reports

## Product-specific details
Each product's privacy page explains what it stores.

title: How RanEddie uses your information
description: Why we use the data we collect.
body:
## To run products
Sign you in, store your files, sync progress and deliver what you ask for.

## To keep you safe
Detect fraud, spam, malware and account takeovers.

## To improve
Fix bugs and improve features, using aggregated information where possible.

## To personalise
Recommendations — which you can turn off.

title: Download your data
description: Get a copy of your information.
body:
## Steps
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose products and a format.
4. We'll email you when the download is ready.

## Good to know
Large exports can take a few days. Download links expire after 7 days.

title: Delete your data
description: Remove information from RanEddie products.
body:
## Delete specific items
Most products let you delete individual items — files, history, messages.

## Delete activity
Clear watch history, AI activity and search history in Privacy.

## Delete everything
[Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

title: Personalised recommendations
description: Control personalisation across RanEddie.
body:
## Turn off
1. Open Privacy in your Account Center.
2. Turn off Personalised recommendations.

## What changes
You'll still see suggestions, but they won't be based on your activity.

title: Advertising and RanEddie
description: How ads work in RanEddie products.
body:
## Where ads appear
Some free products may show ads. Paid plans are ad-free where offered.

## What's never used
The content of your emails, documents, files and photos is never used for ads.

## Your choices
Turn off ad personalisation in Privacy.

title: Cookies on RanEddie websites
description: How raneddie.com and our services use cookies.
body:
## Essential cookies
Keep you signed in and keep your account secure.

## Preferences
Remember settings such as dark mode.

## Manage
Use your browser settings to block or delete cookies. Blocking essential cookies stops sign-in from working.

title: Location information
description: When RanEddie products use your location.
body:
## Examples
- Find My Lu
- Gimbly no-fly zones
- SkyPear nearest restaurants and delivery
- Weather on Lu Watch

## Control it
Allow or deny location access in your device settings for each app.

title: Privacy for children and teens
description: How we protect younger users.
body:
## Under 13
Children under 13 can't create a RanEddie ID. Products like Snake Brawl limit features for younger players, like generated nicknames and no real-money purchases.

## Teens
Teens get stricter privacy defaults.

## Parents
Use [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

title: Who can see your profile
description: What other people see about you.
body:
## Visible to others
Your username and photo, in products where you interact with others.

## Private
Your email, date of birth, country and security settings.

title: Sharing and permissions
description: Control what you share with others.
body:
## Files and albums
Choose View or Edit and who has the link in Cloudly and workIT.

## Review regularly
Open Shared with others in Cloudly to see everything you've shared.

title: Privacy in BlueBear Stream
description: What BlueBear Stream stores.
body:
## Stored
- Profiles
- Watch history
- Ratings
- Downloads

## Control
Delete history per profile and turn off recommendations.

title: Privacy on Lu devices
description: How Lu protects your information.
body:
## On-device
Many features, like photo search and wake-phrase detection, run on the device.

## App permissions
Choose which apps can use your camera, microphone, location and photos.

## Health data
Health data is encrypted and only shared with apps you allow.

title: Privacy in Snake Brawl
description: Snake Brawl's approach to privacy.
body:
## On your phone
Progress, coins and settings are stored on your phone.

## No ads or analytics
Snake Brawl doesn't show ads or include analytics.

## RanEddie ID
If you connect your RanEddie ID, your save is backed up to the cloud.

title: Privacy in rEmail
description: How rEmail protects your mail.
body:
## Not for ads
rEmail doesn't use your email content for advertising.

## Encryption
Messages are encrypted in transit and at rest.

## Spam filtering
Automated systems scan for spam and threats to protect you.

title: Privacy in Cloudly
description: Your files stay yours.
body:
## Ownership
You own what you store in Cloudly.

## Encryption
Files are encrypted in transit and at rest.

## Access
Only you and the people you share with can open your files.

title: Privacy with Gimbly
description: Flying responsibly around other people.
body:
## Privacy mode
Blurs people who aren't added to your shot.

## Respect others
- Don't fly over private property without permission
- Don't record people without their consent
- Follow local laws

title: Privacy at SkyPear
description: What the SkyPear app stores.
body:
## Stored
- Orders
- Addresses
- Favourite restaurants
- Pear Points

## Delete
Clear order history and saved addresses in the app.

title: Privacy in RanEddie Invest
description: How financial information is handled.
body:
## Required by law
Identity verification and transaction records are required by financial regulations and are kept for the period the law requires.

## Security
Strong encryption and two-step verification protect your account.

title: Privacy in Protector Y
description: What Protector Y needs to protect you.
body:
## Threat information
Details about detected threats help protect everyone.

## Your vault
Your password vault is encrypted with a key only you have.

title: Privacy in workIT
description: Your documents stay private.
body:
## Not for ads
workIT content is never used for advertising.

## Business accounts
Organisations control retention and access for their members.

title: Privacy in EditTime
description: How EditTime handles your media.
body:
## Local and cloud
Projects can live on your computer or in Cloudly.

## AI processing
AI features only process media in your project.

title: Privacy for baseline developers
description: Responsibilities when you build on baseline.
body:
## Your users' data
You control the data your app stores in baseline and are responsible for your own privacy policy.

## Our role
baseline processes data on your behalf and keeps it secure.

title: How long RanEddie keeps data
description: Data retention explained.
body:
## While you use it
We keep your content while your account is active.

## After deletion
Deleted content is removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Legal requirements
Some records, like financial transactions, are kept as the law requires.

title: Data transfers between countries
description: Where your data may be processed.
body:
## Global services
RanEddie products may process data in several countries, with safeguards to protect it.

## Choose a region
Cloudly and baseline customers can choose where their data is stored.

title: Your privacy rights
description: Rights you may have over your data.
body:
## Depending on where you live
- Access your data
- Correct it
- Delete it
- Download it
- Object to certain uses

## How
Most rights can be used in your Account Center. Contact us for anything else.

title: Make a privacy request
description: Contact us about your personal data.
body:
## How
Email [contact@raneddie.com](mailto:contact@raneddie.com) from the address on your account with 'Privacy request' in the subject.

## Verification
We may ask you to confirm your identity.

title: Microphone and camera access
description: Control which apps can use them.
body:
## On Lu devices
Settings > Privacy > Camera / Microphone.

## In browsers
Allow or block from the address bar.

## Indicators
Lu devices show a dot when the camera or microphone is in use.

title: Diagnostics and crash reports
description: Help us fix problems — your choice.
body:
## What they include
Technical details about errors, not your content.

## Turn off
Settings > Privacy > Diagnostics in each product.

title: Third-party apps and your data
description: Apps that connect to your RanEddie ID.
body:
## Approval
Apps only get the details you approve.

## Review
Disconnect apps from Connected products in your Account Center.

title: Public Wi-Fi and privacy
description: Stay private on networks you don't control.
body:
## Tips
- Use Protector Y's VPN
- Look for the padlock in your browser
- Avoid sensitive tasks on unknown networks

title: Private browsing
description: What private windows do and don't do.
body:
## They do
Stop your device from saving history and cookies after you close the window.

## They don't
Hide your activity from websites, your network or your internet provider.

title: Privacy glossary
description: Plain explanations of privacy terms.
body:
## Terms
- **Personal information** — information about you
- **Encryption** — scrambling data so only the right people can read it
- **Retention** — how long data is kept
- **Consent** — your permission
- **Anonymised** — data that can't identify you

title: Privacy policy
description: Where to find the full policy.
body:
## Read it
The full RanEddie ID privacy policy is at [id.raneddie.com/privacy](https://id.raneddie.com/privacy).

## Changes
We'll tell you about important changes before they take effect.

title: Security checklist
description: Ten minutes to a safer account.
body:
## Do these today
- Use a unique password of at least 15 characters
- Turn on two-step verification
- Review active sessions
- Check your recovery email
- Install updates on your devices
- Install Protector Y

title: Recognise phishing
description: Spot fake messages that try to steal your account.
body:
## Warning signs
- Urgent threats like 'your account will be closed'
- Links to addresses that aren't raneddie.com
- Requests for passwords or codes
- Unexpected attachments

## Remember
RanEddie will never ask for your password or a verification code.

title: I clicked a suspicious link
description: What to do next.
body:
## Act quickly
1. Don't enter any details on the page.
2. Change your RanEddie ID password if you entered it.
3. Revoke unknown sessions.
4. Run a Protector Y scan.

title: My account was hacked
description: Secure your RanEddie ID.
body:
## Steps
1. Reset your password.
2. Revoke all sessions in Security.
3. Turn on two-step verification.
4. Check your email, connected products and payment methods.
5. Contact support if you can't get in.

title: Unknown sign-in alert
description: You got an email about a sign-in you don't recognise.
body:
## If it was you
No action needed.

## If it wasn't
Change your password and revoke the session immediately.

title: Keep your devices updated
description: Why updates matter.
body:
## Updates fix security holes
Attackers target known weaknesses in out-of-date software.

## Turn on automatic updates
On Lu devices, RanEddie Core, Gimbly and Protector Y.

title: Protect your phone
description: Basic security for your phone.
body:
## Steps
- Use a screen lock
- Turn on Find My Lu
- Only install apps from trusted stores
- Review app permissions
- Back up to Cloudly

title: Protect your computer
description: Basic security for your computer.
body:
## Steps
- Install Protector Y
- Keep the operating system updated
- Use a standard (non-admin) account day to day
- Back up important files

title: Lost or stolen device
description: What to do right away.
body:
## Steps
1. Use Find My Lu to locate or lock it.
2. Revoke its session in your Account Center.
3. Change your password.
4. Report a stolen phone to your carrier.

title: Ransomware: what to know
description: How ransomware works and how to stay safe.
body:
## What it is
Malware that locks your files and demands payment.

## Prevention
- Turn on Protector Y's ransomware shield
- Keep backups in Cloudly
- Don't open unexpected attachments

title: Scam calls and messages
description: People pretending to be RanEddie.
body:
## We will never
- Call asking for your password
- Ask for gift cards
- Ask you to install remote-access software

## Report it
Forward suspicious emails to contact@raneddie.com.

title: Secure your home Wi-Fi
description: Protect your network.
body:
## Steps
- Change the router's default password
- Use WPA3 or WPA2 encryption
- Update router firmware
- Use a guest network for visitors

title: Backup codes
description: A way in if you lose your authenticator.
body:
## Save them
Store backup codes somewhere safe and offline.

## Each code works once
Generate new ones when you run low.

title: Security for teams
description: Admin tools for organisations.
body:
## Recommended
- Require two-step verification
- Use single sign-on
- Review admin roles
- Set sharing limits in Cloudly

title: Report a security vulnerability
description: Found a security issue in a RanEddie product?
body:
## How
Email [contact@raneddie.com](mailto:contact@raneddie.com) with 'Security' in the subject and enough detail to reproduce the issue.

## Please
Don't access other people's data or disrupt services while testing.

title: Encryption at RanEddie
description: How we protect data in transit and at rest.
body:
## In transit
Connections to RanEddie services use modern TLS encryption.

## At rest
Stored data in Cloudly, rEmail and workIT is encrypted.

title: Safe online shopping
description: Shop safely in the BlueBear Shop, RanEddie Part and beyond.
body:
## Tips
- Check the address is correct
- Use a credit card or trusted payment method
- Be wary of deals that look too good

title: Gaming account security
description: Keep your RanEddie Games account safe.
body:
## Tips
- Never share your password with friends
- Ignore offers of free coins or items
- Turn on two-step verification

title: Securing a baseline project
description: Security best practices for developers.
body:
## Checklist
- Turn on row-level security for every table
- Never expose the service key
- Restrict auth redirect URLs
- Rotate keys if they leak

title: Securing Cloudly resources
description: Protect servers and storage.
body:
## Checklist
- Keep buckets private
- Use least-privilege access keys
- Close unused ports
- Turn on audit logs

title: Email security in rEmail
description: Stay safe in your inbox.
body:
## Built in
- Spam and phishing filtering
- Attachment scanning
- Warnings for unverified senders

title: Password manager basics
description: Why use one and how to start.
body:
## Why
A password manager remembers a unique password for every site.

## Start
Set up Protector Y's password manager and import passwords from your browser.

title: Data breach: what to do
description: Your details appeared in a breach.
body:
## Steps
1. Change the password for the breached site.
2. Change it anywhere you reused it.
3. Turn on two-step verification.
4. Watch for phishing that uses the breached details.

title: Safe use of public computers
description: Using computers in libraries or hotels.
body:
## Tips
- Use a private window
- Never save passwords
- Sign out completely
- Avoid banking or investing

title: Child safety online
description: Help kids stay safe.
body:
## Tips
- Use family settings
- Talk about what to share
- Keep devices in shared spaces
- Teach them to tell you about anything upsetting

title: Malware on phones
description: Signs your phone may be infected.
body:
## Signs
- Battery drains fast
- Unknown apps
- Pop-ups everywhere
- Unexpected charges

## Fix
Run a Protector Y scan and remove unknown apps.

title: Secure your RanEddie Invest account
description: Extra steps for financial accounts.
body:
## Steps
- Turn on two-step verification
- Use a unique password
- Turn on login alerts
